purpose: Prospective offline two-stage Earnings-21 pipeline over the frozen full44 discovery roster. Stage 1 generates a new direct transcript for every fixed 90-second window through the current shared OpenJiuwen executor and formal full-window packets. After the whole roster seals, a model-free batch barrier binds those exact new window responses as the predecessor of the existing KC-E1f brief repair. Stage 2 then repairs those same windows. The system result is the stage-2 output and its cost includes both stages.

population.selection: The complete frozen discovery roster and its complete fixed 90-second tiling; no outcome-based selection.

stage_1.terminal_material: Every terminal per-window response from this new stage-1 run, recovered only after the complete raw parent seals.

barrier.timing: After stage 1 is complete and verified, before any quality or reference read and before stage 2 is composed.
barrier.selection_rule: Recover every terminal stage-1 window in stitch order from the sealed trace; require the recovered windows to rebuild all 44 sealed call outputs byte for byte; bind exactly 1,593 unique window ids, bounds, request ids, saturation flags and text hashes to the source manifest, outputs and trace hashes.
barrier.materialization_rule: Write the model-output-bearing snapshot below SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR and an English content-free receipt under docs/receipts. The stage-2 successor must pin the receipt path and measured SHA-256. No response content or quality statistic is inspected to choose or alter the binding.
barrier.historical_predecessor_forbidden: The receipt docs/receipts/e21-predecessor-full44-direct-baseline-v2.json must not satisfy this barrier; its run and attempt identities differ from the newly sealed stage-1 parent.

stage_2.baseline_basis: configs/baseline/e21-kc-e1f-brief-repair.json plus the current shared OJW/formal-packet transport fields; replace only its historical predecessor_snapshot with the newly materialized stage-1 binding.

service_geometry.status: The geometry matches the validated E21 np4 decoder-only packet route. The direct fit remains held for the terminal full-roster model-free wire receipt; generation remains held for the resulting exact 1,593-request fit and root admission.

readiness.reason: Pre-registered only. Generation remains held until the actual 1,593-request fit passes under max1024 and root binds its immutable request-fit receipt and separate admission.

repair_template.status: Frozen before the direct parent runs; materialize only its predecessor_snapshot receipt path and measured SHA-256 after the direct parent seals.

prospective_parent_contract.status: The contract embeds the final composed configuration and protocol hashes and is intentionally not self-hash-pinned by this fragment.

fit_execution_plan.basis: One GET /props plus one /apply-template and two /tokenize calls for each of 1,593 actual formal-packet requests. The fit performs no generation and remains held until the complete model-free wire terminates successfully.

preparation_scheduling: Root allocates eight aggregate CPU preparation workers. Current serial full-wire proof remains preserved; this preparation concurrency changes no sample, window, packet, prompt or decoding policy. Both stages retain depth1prefetch. Exact whole-roster fits check the unchanged requests with2x output reserve.
